crossRefs.note: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
“You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.
“Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy…
Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…
But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.”…
But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

people.name: Jerusalem

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.
